headword: {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A train that skips some stations to provide faster service than a local train, but stops at more stations than a limited express.

examples.japanese: {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}に{乗|の}り{換|か}える。
examples.english: To transfer to an express train.

examples.japanese: この{駅|えき}には{急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}は{止|と}まりません。
examples.english: Express trains do not stop at this station.

examples.japanese: {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}の{本数|ほんすう}が{減|へ}らされたため、{通勤客|つうきんきゃく}から{不満|ふまん}の{声|こえ}が{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: Because the number of express trains was reduced, commuters are voicing their dissatisfaction.

notes:
A compound of {急行|きゅうこう} (express) and {列車|れっしゃ} (train). In the Japanese train classification system, {急行|きゅうこう} sits between {普通|ふつう}/{各停|かくてい} (local) and {特急|とっきゅう} (limited express) in terms of speed and number of stops. Many JR {急行|きゅうこう} services have been discontinued or upgraded to {特急|とっきゅう}, but the term remains common on private railways.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}に{乗|の}る: to ride an express train
- {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}の{停車駅|ていしゃえき}: stations where the express stops
- {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}が{通過|つうか}する: the express passes through
- {急行|きゅうこう}{料金|りょうきん}: express surcharge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}: limited express train — faster, with fewer stops and usually a surcharge
- {快速|かいそく}: rapid train — a category between local and express on some lines; no surcharge
- {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}: local train — stops at every station
